[1/3] Plan viewport translate gizmo with axis handles, drag preview and one transform action on release

impact_assessment.why: The editor can select nodes but cannot manipulate them directly in the viewport, unlike Unity/Unreal; users must type coordinates or nudge with keys.
impact_assessment.benefits: Axis-constrained translation by dragging X/Y/Z handles, world-space drag preview, and exactly one validated transform action per completed drag so undo stays clean.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none, pure WebGL/JS; concurrency: gizmo drag must pre-empt camera orbit on the same pointer; state: preview mutates world matrices and must restore on cancel.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep gizmo drag state separate from camera drag, derive the final local position through the parent world inverse, restore previewed matrices on cancel, add static tests and run node --check plus the full gate cycle.

[1/4] Plan prefab instance links with revert/apply, persisted through prefab and scene snapshots

impact_assessment.why: Inserted prefabs are detached copies: later prefab edits cannot reach instances, and instance overrides are indistinguishable from authored nodes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every single-root insertion carries a stable prefab/instance link, AI clients see it in the editor document, and revert/apply actions make prefab workflows reversible and repeatable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prefab, scene-snapshot and editor schema bumps; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock unchanged; state: undo snapshots, saved scenes and rollback on failed library writes must preserve links.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Accept prior prefab/snapshot versions, keep links on Node in snapshots, test revert/apply/undo/save paths, and run the full gate cycle.

[1/3] Plan local-axis rotate and scale gizmos with previews, snapping and one transform action per drag

impact_assessment.why: The viewport only translates; Unity/Unreal-style authoring needs rotate and scale handles for direct manipulation.
impact_assessment.benefits: W/E/R transform modes, local-axis rotation and scale previews, Ctrl/Cmd snapping (15 degrees / 0.1 scale), and one validated transform action plus one undo entry per drag.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: the existing gizmo drag state must arbitrate with camera orbit; state: preview world matrices must restore on cancel.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extend the existing gizmo drag lifecycle, derive local quaternion/scale in app.js, add static tests and node --check, then run the full gate cycle.
